text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After running through today's practice schedule, I decide to call it a day when King Halo protests.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This amount of practice is simply insufficient!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I can't just do what everyone else does if I want to prove that I'm a first-rate Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I must tackle even routine training with more effort and passion than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why we're adding on extra training! You must make certain I'm in top form!
choice_data_list: First-rate runners also have to know when to call it a day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's precisely why you're my trainer. Now I'm bursting with energy and ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give King Halo all the training she can handle.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Urk… "When to call it a day," huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's true… Pushing yourself so hard you get sick is certainly not first-rate…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So you're saying that the most important thing to do is…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To stay in top condition so I can always give one hundred percent?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: In that case, I suppose I can accept this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll rest up and not overdo it… All for the sake of continuing my first-rate reign!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we talk it out, King Halo decides to refrain from extra training.
